limits: Local microbenchmarks, not measured gdev frame times.
Paired timings include fixture setup, execution and full result decoding. Equality checks occur outside timing.

Refit and cast paired controls use the current storage with the previous copy/traversal algorithm. Previous-source controls overlay the exact saved sources, with only scene/tree compatibility constructors.
Prepared UI timing includes one preparation and 16 text-edit settlements. Final marking still scans every node.
Sparse BVH conversion is linear on the first sparse update. Small trees and dense edits retain contiguous storage.
Dense scene at 2048 sources was about 12% slower in the final previous-source control; other dense/physics controls were near baseline.
Nearest search was 11-14% slower in the mixed regression run, then 1-2% slower in the isolated repeat. Both sets of samples are retained.
Committed linear-memory capacity is not live allocation traffic, peak RSS, or host heap size. Warm replay growth was zero.
Storage type changes require caller migration: scene proxy accessors, paged spatial bounds, points.Index, and tree.from_nodes/prepared_tree.
No gdev migration, parallel ECS execution, compiler change, commit or push is part of this task.
